column1: # The corrected copy of three of the PINS.tsv datasets, pinned to one commit.
# NormB/vcon-datasets-core04 adds the mediatype that draft-ietf-vcon-vcon-core-04
# section 4.4.5 requires on inline attachments, and changes nothing else; its
# CHANGES.md lists what it leaves open. scripts/fetch-vcon-datasets.py fetches
# it beside the upstream datasets. Commit recorded 2026-10-09. License: the
# SPDX identifier of the repository's own LICENSE file; each dataset directory
# in it keeps its upstream LICENSE.
